name: Essence Drain Occultist
summary: Chaos damage over time on the Occultist shell. Essence Drain and Contagion spread through a pack, Wither and Despair amplify the damage, and the build spends most of its time moving. No required unique.

pros.text: Damage over time keeps working while you move.
No required unique; spell damage and chaos scaling carry the build.
Contagion turns one kill into a pack-wide clear.
Occultist curses and Withering Presence improve the boss fight.
A safe caster for players who dislike standing still.
The same spell sceptre and shield as the Arc builds.

cons.text: Damage is delayed; you have to wait for the DoT to finish.
Single-target needs Wither and curse uptime.
Clear speed is slower than a hit-based bow build.
Chaos resistance is hard to cap without specific gear.
The build wants a six-link for its best damage.
Contagion spread can feel awkward in open layouts.

pantheon.note: Gruthkul reduces the physical hits that catch a caster in a bad position.

summary.text: Essence Drain Occultist is a chaos damage-over-time build that measures 73.5k at red maps and 103.5k at pinnacle. The damage keeps working while you move, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Essence Drain and Contagion, then add the DoT supports as they unlock. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 60 damage; the second measures 478.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 73.5k damage, 13538 effective life and 5089 physical max hit. Spread Contagion, keep Wither on the rare, and cap the resistances.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 103.5k damage with 13159 effective life and 4927 physical max hit. Apply Despair and Wither before the burst, then keep moving while the DoT works.
